summary: Added docshelf/access.py (Rules plus role, suspended, is_admin, acting_for, can_read/write/share/delete) and moved every check out of listing, show, edit, share, delete and audit, each now with a module-level RULES that reproduces its old behavior. The existing tests and the new tests/test_access.py pass, and a differential fuzz of 28,800 random commands against a rebuilt copy of the original package gave identical output, exit status and workspace files. Quirks kept as they were: edit and share/delete read roles, suspension and grant ends differently from list/show; show counts users with no team as members of no-team documents; edit trusts any '*' grant while the readers need an admin granter; and delegates can edit but not share or delete.
